app.name: L-D-Maker Studio
app.tagline: From the brand's sources to a module ready for its LMS.
welcome.title: Welcome to the Studio
welcome.intro: Two settings and you're ready. You can change them at any time in Settings.
welcome.name.label: Your first name
welcome.name.help: It appears in approvals and tells your partner you are working on a project.
welcome.folder.label: Projects folder
welcome.folder.help: Pick a folder in your shared cloud space: you and your partner will see the same projects.
projects.title: Projects
projects.empty.title: No projects yet
projects.empty.body: Create your first project: the brand's brief, its documents, your format and design choices.
new.title: New project
new.essentials.title: Course title
new.essentials.audienceHelp: For example: boutique sales advisers, after-sales team, wholesale partners.
new.essentials.briefHelp: Paste the brief as you received it: goals, key messages, constraints. It stays in the project folder.
new.sources.intro: Add the brand's documents: PDF, PowerPoint, Word, text. They are copied into the project, then read to draw the content from them.
new.sources.none: No files yet. You can also add some later.
new.languages.help: Translations are produced once you approve the reference text; plan a native review before delivery.
new.output.intro: Where will the course be published? You can pick several: one package is produced for each.
new.output.preparing: Specific settings in preparation: standard SCORM package meanwhile.
new.design.brandHelp: Optional. Contrast is checked before every export; an unreadable colour is adjusted and reported.
new.design.animationHelp: Always off for learners who ask for reduced motion.
new.assessment.typesRequired: Choose at least one question type.
new.summary.intro: Check before creating the project. Everything can still be changed afterwards.
profile.teach-on-mars.help: The FHH app for boutiques and wholesale.
profile.lms-unknown.help: SCORM 1.2, accepted by almost every LMS.
profile.scorm2004-generic.help: For an LMS that explicitly asks for SCORM 2004.
profile.html-file.help: One file to send or open offline, without tracking.
profile.html-site.help: A web folder to put on a server, without LMS tracking.
theme.lumiere.help: Warm paper, serif headings, copper accent.
animation.sober.help: Discreet transitions, nothing moves without an action.
animation.standard.help: Gentle reveals of content and feedback.
question.hotspot: Identify a part on an image
project.locked: {name} opened this project ({time}). It is read-only so that your changes do not cross.
project.sourcesStale: Sources changed since the last reading: {files}.
project.noSources: No sources. Add the brand's documents to start.
project.assessmentValue: {types}; {n} questions per objective, passing score {score} %, {attempts} attempt(s)
project.next.sources: Add the brand's documents, then have them read.
project.next.storyboard: Generate the storyboard with Claude: coming in Studio step 2 (generation engine).
project.next.approval: The storyboard is waiting for your approval.
project.next.module: Writing the module comes in Studio step 4.
settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Your first name
settings.apiKeyHelp: Used to generate storyboards and modules. It is encrypted by your computer's keychain and never goes into the shared folder.
settings.apiKeyNoKeychain: This system offers no secure keychain: the key cannot be stored.
